lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 5 distinct, high-contrast vertical white lines are visible on the mid-to-posterior torso; spacing is roughly equidistant across the mid-flank with slight narrowing toward the haunch.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Vertical lines exhibit tapering and termination before reaching the ventral boundary of the torso, particularly the third and fourth lines from the shoulder.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 3-4 high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower posterior haunch, situated above the white marking of the hind limb.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns exhibit a spiral lyrate curvature, angling outward from the pedicles before curving inward and upward toward the apex.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: Estimated 1.5:1 ratio of inter-tip distance relative to the visible base width of the primary horn.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: Approximate 0.12 ratio of high-contrast ivory tipping relative to the total vertical horn structure.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.other_distinctive_markers: Long, white-tipped dorsal mane extending along the spine; prominent white transverse bands on the lower limbs and a distinct white chevron-like marking on the lower leg.
